translations.idiomatic: He named Shanchang right chancellor, Xu Da left chancellor, and Chang Yuchun and Yu Tonghai pingzhang, telling them, "In founding a state one must first set discipline and law in order.

sentences.zh: 元氏暗弱，威福下移，馴至於亂，今宜鑒之。

translations.literal: The Yuan house was benighted and weak; authority and favor shifted downward, leading step by step to chaos—now we ought to take warning from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan grew dim and feeble until power slipped to the base and disorder followed in train; take that as a warning."

sentences.zh: 」立子標為世子。

translations.literal: He established his son Biao as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He named his son Biao heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，復自將征武昌，陳理降，漢、沔、荊、岳皆下。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yiwei he again personally led a campaign against Wuchang; Chen Li surrendered; Han, Mian, Jing, and Yue all fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the second month he marched on Wuchang in person again; Chen Li surrendered, and Han, Mian, Jing, and Yue all submitted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，還應天。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day yichou he returned to Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the third month he returned to Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，置起居注。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao he established the office of court diarist.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day he instituted the office of court diarist.

sentences.zh: 庚午，罷諸翼元帥府，置十七衛親軍指揮使司，命中書省辟文武人材。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu he abolished the various wing marshal headquarters, established seventeen guards of the personal-army command, and ordered the Secretariat to recruit civil and military talent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he abolished the wing marshal headquarters, created seventeen personal-army guard commands, and ordered the Secretariat to recruit men of civil and military talent.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，建祠，祀死事丁普郎等於康郎山，趙德勝等於南昌。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer he built shrines and sacrificed to those who died in service, Ding Pulang and others at Kanglang Mountain and Zhao Desheng and others at Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer he raised shrines to the fallen—Ding Pulang and his comrades at Kanglang Mountain, Zhao Desheng and his at Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，徐達克盧州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the day dingchou, Xu Da took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the seventh month of autumn Xu Da captured Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，常遇春徇江西。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Chang Yuchun reduced Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Chang Yuchun swept Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，復吉安，遂圍贛州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day wuxu he recovered Ji'an and then besieged Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the eighth month he recovered Ji'an and then invested Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 達徇荊、湘諸路。

translations.literal: Xu Da reduced the routes of Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da campaigned through the Jing and Xiang circuits.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，下江陵，夷陵、潭、歸皆降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jiashen he took Jiangling; Yiling, Tan, and Gui all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the ninth month he took Jiangling; Yiling, Tan, and Gui all came over.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚寅，達克辰州，遣別將下衡州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter on the day gengyin, Xu Da took Chenzhou and sent a separate general to take Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the twelfth month of winter Xu Da seized Chenzhou and detached a column to take Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月己巳，徐達下寶慶，湖湘平。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-fifth year, on the day jisi of the first month, Xu Da took Baojing; Hunan and the Xiang region were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the first month of spring in the twenty-fifth year Xu Da took Baojing, and Hunan and the Xiang basin were pacified.

sentences.zh: 常遇春克贛州，熊天瑞降。

translations.literal: Chang Yuchun took Ganzhou; Xiong Tianrui surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Yuchun captured Ganzhou and Xiong Tianrui surrendered.

sentences.zh: 遂趨南安，招諭嶺南諸路，下韶州、南雄。

translations.literal: He then pressed toward Nan'an, summoned and instructed the routes of Lingnan, and took Shaozhou and Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: He then drove toward Nan'an, won over the Lingnan circuits by proclamation, and took Shaozhou and Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 甲申，如南昌，執大都督硃文正以歸，數其罪，安置桐城。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen he went to Nanchang, seized the grand commander Zhu Wenzhang and brought him back, listed his crimes, and settled him at Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he went to Nanchang, arrested Grand Commander Zhu Wenzhang, brought him home, arraigned him for his offenses, and confined him at Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，福建行省平章陳友定侵處州，參軍胡深擊敗之，遂下浦城。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jichou, the Fujian Branch Secretariat pingzhang Chen Youding invaded Chuzhou; the staff officer Hu Shen defeated him and then took Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the second month Chen Youding, pingzhang of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, attacked Chuzhou; Staff Officer Hu Shen routed him and then captured Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，士誠將李伯升攻諸全之新城，李文忠大敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Shicheng's general Li Bosheng attacked the new city of Zhuji; Li Wenzhong greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Shicheng's general Li Bosheng assaulted Zhuji's new fortress; Li Wenzhong crushed him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，常遇春徇襄、漢諸路。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on the day gengyin, Chang Yuchun reduced the routes of Xiang and Han.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the fourth month of summer Chang Yuchun campaigned through the Xiang and Han circuits.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，克安陸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day yihai he took Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the fifth month he captured Anlu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，下襄陽。

translations.literal: On the day jimao he took Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he took Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，硃亮祖、胡深攻建寧，戰於城下，深被執，死之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day renzi, Zhu Liangzu and Hu Shen attacked Jianning and fought below the walls; Shen was captured and died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the sixth month Zhu Liangzu and Hu Shen assaulted Jianning and battled beneath the walls; Hu Shen was taken and killed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，令從渡江士卒被創廢疾者養之，死者贍其妻子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he ordered that soldiers who had crossed the Yangzi and were wounded or disabled be cared for, and that the wives and children of the dead be supported.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn he decreed pensions for the men who had crossed the Yangzi and been wounded or crippled, and support for the families of the dead.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，建國子學。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingchen he established the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the ninth month he founded the National University.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，下令討張士誠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on the day wuxu he issued orders to campaign against Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the tenth month of winter he ordered a campaign against Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 是時，士誠所據，南至紹興，北有通、泰、高郵、淮安、濠、泗，又北至於濟寧。

translations.literal: At that time the territory Shicheng held ran south to Shaoxing; in the north he held Tong, Tai, Gaoyou, Huai'an, Hao, and Si, and still farther north to Jining.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shicheng's domain stretched south to Shaoxing and north through Tongzhou, Taizhou, Gaoyou, Huai'an, Hao, and Si to Jining.

sentences.zh: 乃命徐達、常遇春等先規取淮東。

translations.literal: He thereupon ordered Xu Da, Chang Yuchun, and others first to plan the taking of Huai east.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered Xu Da, Chang Yuchun, and the rest to secure Huai east first.

sentences.zh: 閏月，圍泰州，克之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month he besieged Taizhou and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month he invested Taizhou and captured it.

sentences.zh: 十一月，張士誠寇宜興，徐達擊敗之，遂自宜興還攻高郵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Zhang Shicheng raided Yixing; Xu Da defeated him and then, from Yixing, turned back to attack Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang Shicheng struck at Yixing; Xu Da beat him off and, swinging from Yixing, laid siege to Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月癸未，士誠窺江陰，太祖自將救之，士誠遁，康茂才追敗之於浮子門。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year, on the day guimao of the first month, Shicheng probed Jiangyin; Taizu personally led troops to rescue it; Shicheng fled; Kang Maocai pursued and defeated him at Fuzi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the first month of spring in the twenty-sixth year Shicheng tested Jiangyin; Taizu marched to its relief in person; Shicheng withdrew; and Kang Maocai ran him down and routed him at Fuzi Gate.

sentences.zh: 太祖還應天。

translations.literal: Taizu returned to Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu returned to Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 二月，明玉珍死，子升自立。

translations.literal: In the second month Ming Yuzhen died; his son Sheng established himself in power.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Ming Yuzhen died, and his son Sheng took power.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，令中書嚴選舉。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day bingshen he ordered the Secretariat to conduct recruitment with strict standards.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the third month he ordered the Secretariat to tighten standards for official recruitment.

sentences.zh: 徐達克高郵。

translations.literal: Xu Da took Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da captured Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，襲破士誠將徐義水軍於淮安，義遁，梅思祖以城降。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on the day yimao he raided and broke Shicheng's general Xu Yi's navy at Huai'an; Yi fled; Mei Sizu surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fourth month of summer he surprised and shattered Xu Yi's fleet at Huai'an; Xu Yi fled and Mei Sizu surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 濠、徐、宿三州相繼下，淮東平。

translations.literal: The three prefectures of Hao, Xu, and Su fell in succession, and Huai east was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hao, Xu, and Su prefectures fell one after another, and Huai east was pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如濠州省墓，置守冢二十家，賜故人汪文、劉英粟帛。

translations.literal: On day jiazi he went to Haozhou to visit the tombs, established twenty households to guard the graves, and granted grain and cloth to old friends Wang Wen and Liu Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he went to Haozhou to tend the family graves, posted twenty households to keep them, and gave grain and cloth to old friends Wang Wen and Liu Ying.

sentences.zh: 置酒召父老飲，極歡，曰：「吾去鄉十有余年，艱難百戰，乃得歸省墳墓，與父老子弟復相見。

translations.literal: He set out wine and summoned the elders to drink, rejoicing greatly, saying: "I have been away from my native place more than ten years, through a hundred hard-fought battles, before I could return to visit the graves and see you elders and your sons and younger brothers again.
translations.idiomatic: He set out wine and called the village elders to drink with him in high spirits, saying, "I left home more than ten years ago and fought a hundred bitter battles before I could come back to tend the graves and stand among you elders and your sons and brothers again.

sentences.zh: 今苦不得久留歡聚為樂。

translations.literal: Now I bitterly cannot stay long to make merry together.
translations.idiomatic: Now I grieve that I cannot stay long enough to enjoy this reunion.

sentences.zh: 父老幸教子弟孝弟力田，毋遠賈，濱淮郡縣尚苦寇掠，父老善自愛。

translations.literal: Elders, I hope you will teach your sons and younger brothers filial piety, brotherly duty, and diligent farming—do not go far to trade. The Huai-bank commanderies and counties still suffer bandit raids; take good care of yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: Teach your sons and younger brothers filial piety, brotherly duty, and hard work in the fields—do not wander far to trade. The counties along the Huai still suffer raids; look after yourselves well."

sentences.zh: 」令有司除租賦，皆頓首謝。

translations.literal: He ordered the officials to remit rent and taxes; all bowed their heads in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the local offices to waive rent and taxes, and the elders all bowed their heads in thanks.

sentences.zh: 辛未，徐達克安豐，分兵敗擴廓於徐州。

translations.literal: On day xinwei Xu Da took Anfeng and detached troops to defeat Köke Temür at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Xu Da captured Anfeng and detached a column that routed Köke Temür at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，至自濠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on day renwu, he returned from Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu day, he returned from Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，求遺書。

translations.literal: On day gengyin he sought lost books.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he ordered a search for lost books.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，改築應天城，作新宮鐘山之陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on day gengxu, he rebuilt the walls of Yingtian and built a new palace on the sunny south slope of Bell Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengxu day, he rebuilt the walls of Yingtian and began a new palace on the southern face of Bell Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命徐達為大將軍，常遇春為副將軍，帥師二十萬討張士誠。

translations.literal: On day xinhai he appointed Xu Da grand general and Chang Yuchun vice grand general, commanding two hundred thousand troops to attack Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day he named Xu Da grand general and Chang Yuchun vice grand general and gave them two hundred thousand men to campaign against Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 御戟門誓師曰：「城下之日，毋殺掠，毋毀廬舍，毋發丘壟。

translations.literal: At the Ceremonial Halberd Gate he swore the army, saying: "On the day the city falls—no killing or looting, no destroying houses, no opening graves.
translations.idiomatic: At the Ceremonial Halberd Gate he swore in the army, saying, "When the city falls: no killing, no looting, no wrecking homes, no opening tombs.

sentences.zh: 士誠母葬平江城外，毋侵毀。

translations.literal: Shicheng's mother is buried outside Pingjiang city—do not violate or destroy it."
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng's mother lies buried outside Pingjiang—do not touch her mound."

sentences.zh: 」既而召問達、遇春，用兵當何先。

translations.literal: Then he summoned Xu Da and Chang Yuchun and asked which target the army should strike first.
translations.idiomatic: He then called in Xu Da and Chang Yuchun and asked where the army should strike first.

sentences.zh: 遇春欲直搗平江。

translations.literal: Yuchun wished to drive straight at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchun wanted to march straight on Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「湖州張天騏、杭州潘原明為士誠臂指，平江窮蹙，兩人悉力赴援，難以取勝。

translations.literal: Taizu said: "Zhang Tianqi at Huzhou and Pan Yuanming at Hangzhou are Shicheng's right and left hands. With Pingjiang cornered, both will throw all their strength into relief—it will be hard to win.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu said, "Zhang Tianqi at Huzhou and Pan Yuanming at Hangzhou are Shicheng's arms and eyes. Pingjiang is desperate; both will rush to its aid with everything they have, and victory will be hard.

sentences.zh: 不若先攻湖州，使疲於奔命。

translations.literal: Better to attack Huzhou first and wear them out rushing back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Better to take Huzhou first and wear them down running to and fro.

sentences.zh: 羽翼既披，平江勢孤，立破矣。

translations.literal: Once his wings are clipped, Pingjiang will stand alone and fall at once."
translations.idiomatic: Clip his wings and Pingjiang will stand alone—then it will fall in a stroke."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，敗張天騏於湖州，士誠親率兵來援，覆敗之於皁林。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu he defeated Zhang Tianqi at Huzhou; Shicheng personally led troops to the rescue and was again routed at Zaolin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he defeated Zhang Tianqi at Huzhou; Shicheng led the relief army in person and was routed again at Zaolin.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，李文忠攻杭州。

translations.literal: On day yichou in the ninth month Li Wenzhong attacked Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the ninth month Li Wenzhong attacked Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，遇春敗士誠兵於烏鎮。

translations.literal: On day renzi in the tenth month of winter Yuchun defeated Shicheng's troops at Wuzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the tenth month of winter Yuchun defeated Shicheng's army at Wuzhen.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，張天騏降。

translations.literal: On day jiashen in the eleventh month Zhang Tianqi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the eleventh month Zhang Tianqi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李文忠下余杭，潘原明降，旁郡悉下。

translations.literal: On day xinmao Li Wenzhong took Yuhang; Pan Yuanming surrendered and neighboring commanderies all fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Li Wenzhong took Yuhang; Pan Yuanming surrendered and the neighboring prefectures fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，圍平江。

translations.literal: On day guimao he besieged Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he laid siege to Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，韓林兒卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Han Lin'er died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Han Lin'er died.

sentences.zh: 以明年為吳元年，建廟社宮室，祭告山川。

translations.literal: The next year was taken as the inaugural year of Wu; temples of state, altars, and palaces were built, and sacrifices were announced to rivers and mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The following year was proclaimed the inaugural year of Wu; state temples, altars, and palaces were raised, and offerings were announced to the rivers and mountains.

sentences.zh: 所司進宮殿圖，命去雕琢奇麗者。

translations.literal: The responsible office presented palace plans; he ordered removal of carved ornament and exotic splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices submitted palace designs; he ordered away carving, ornament, and exotic luxury.

sentences.zh: 是歲，元擴廓帖木兒與李思齊、張良弼構怨，屢相攻擊，朝命不行，中原民益困。

translations.literal: That year Yuan Köke Temür bore grudges against Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi; they attacked each other repeatedly, court orders went unheeded, and the people of the central plain grew ever poorer.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yuan general Köke Temür fell out with Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi; they attacked one another again and again, imperial orders no longer ran, and the people of the central plain grew still poorer.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月戊戌，諭中書省曰：「東南久罹兵革，民生凋敝，吾甚憫之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the twenty-seventh year, on day wuxu, he instructed the Secretariat: "The southeast has long suffered war; the people's livelihood is wasted—I pity them deeply.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-seventh year, on wuxu day, he told the Secretariat, "The southeast has long known war; the people's livelihood is in ruins, and I pity them deeply.

sentences.zh: 且太平、應天諸郡，吾渡江開創地，供億煩勞久矣。

translations.literal: Moreover Taiping, Yingtian, and other commanderies are the ground I crossed the river to open; they have long borne the burden of supplying the army.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping, Yingtian, and the other commanderies are the lands I won when I crossed the Yangzi; they have borne the army's supplies for years.

sentences.zh: 今比戶空虛，有司急催科，重困吾民，將何以堪。

translations.literal: Now household after household stands empty, yet the offices urgently press for taxes and again crush my people—how can they bear it?
translations.idiomatic: Household after household stands empty, yet the offices press for taxes as if in haste and crush my people again—how can they endure it?

sentences.zh: 其賜太平田租二年，應天、鎮江、寧國、廣德各一年。

translations.literal: Grant a remission of Taiping field rent for two years, and of Yingtian, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde one year each."
translations.idiomatic: Remit Taiping's field rent for two years, and that of Yingtian, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde one year each."

sentences.zh: 」二月丁未，傅友德敗擴廓將李二於徐州，執之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei in the second month Fu Youde defeated Köke Temür's general Li Er at Xuzhou and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the second month Fu Youde defeated Köke Temür's general Li Er at Xuzhou and took him prisoner.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，始設文武科取士。

translations.literal: On day dingchou in the third month civil and military examinations for selecting scholars were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the third month civil and military examinations for selecting officials were instituted for the first time.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，方國珍陰遣人通擴廓及陳友定，移書責之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Fang Guozhen secretly sent men to communicate with Köke Temür and Chen Youding; Taizu sent a letter rebuking him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Fang Guozhen secretly sent men to open contact with Köke Temür and Chen Youding; Taizu wrote him a stern letter of rebuke.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，初置翰林院。

translations.literal: On day jihai in the fifth month the Hanlin Academy was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the fifth month the Hanlin Academy was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 是月，以旱減膳素食，復徐、宿、濠、泗、壽、邳、東海、安東、襄陽、安陸及新附地田租三年。

translations.literal: That month, because of drought he reduced his meals and ate plain food; he also remitted field rent for three years in Xuzhou, Suzhou, Haozhou, Sizhou, Shou, Pi, East Sea, Andong, Xiangyang, Anlu, and newly submitted territories.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because of drought he cut his meals and ate plain food; he also remitted field rent for three years in Xuzhou, Suzhou, Haozhou, Sizhou, Shou, Pi, East Sea, Andong, Xiangyang, Anlu, and the newly submitted regions.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，大雨，群臣請復膳。

translations.literal: On day wuchen in the sixth month great rain fell; the ministers asked that he resume full meals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the sixth month heavy rain fell; the ministers asked that he restore his usual fare.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「雖雨，傷禾已多，其賜民今年田租。

translations.literal: Taizu said: "Though it rains, much grain has already been damaged—grant the people this year's field rent."
translations.idiomatic: Taizu said, "Even with rain, much grain is already lost—remit this year's field rent for the people."

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，命朝賀罷女樂。

translations.literal: On day guiyou he ordered that female musicians be dismissed from court ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he ordered female musicians removed from court ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，給府州縣官之任費，賜綺帛，及其父母妻長子有差，著為令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day bingzi, he granted traveling expenses to prefectural, departmental, and county officials taking up their posts, bestowing silk and brocade with graded gifts for their parents, wives, and eldest sons, and codified this as an ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingzi day, he granted traveling expenses to officials taking up posts in prefectures, departments, and counties, with graded gifts of silk and brocade for their parents, wives, and eldest sons, and made this a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 己丑，雷震宮門獸吻，赦罪囚。

translations.literal: On day jichou lightning struck the palace gate beast finials; criminal prisoners were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day lightning struck the beast finials on the palace gate; prisoners were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣使責方國珍貢糧。

translations.literal: On day gengyin he sent envoys to demand grain tribute from Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he sent envoys to demand grain tribute from Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，圜丘、方丘、社稷壇成。

translations.literal: On day guichou in the eighth month the Round Mound, Square Mound, and Altars of Soil and Grain were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day in the eighth month the Round Mound, Square Mound, and Altars of Soil and Grain were completed.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，太廟成。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu in the ninth month the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the ninth month the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 硃亮祖帥師討國珍。

translations.literal: Zhu Liangzu led troops against Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Liangzu led an army against Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔曰：「先王之政，罪不及孥。

translations.literal: On day wuyin an edict said: "Under the former kings, guilt did not extend to wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict declared, "Under the ancient kings, guilt did not reach a man's wife and children.

sentences.zh: 自今除大逆不道，毋連坐。

translations.literal: From now on, except for great treason and unrighteous conduct, there shall be no collective punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, except for great treason and unrighteous conduct, there shall be no guilt by association."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，徐達克平江，執士誠，吳地平。

translations.literal: On day xinsi Xu Da took Pingjiang, captured Shicheng, and Wu territory was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Xu Da took Pingjiang, captured Shicheng, and Wu territory was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣使致書於元主，送其宗室神保大王等北還。

translations.literal: On day wuxu he sent envoys with a letter to the Yuan emperor and sent back north the Yuan imperial clansmen including Prince Shenbao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he sent envoys with a letter to the Yuan emperor and sent the Yuan imperial clansmen north, including Prince Shenbao.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，論平吳功，封李善長宣國公，徐達信國公，常遇春鄂國公，將士賜賚有差。

translations.literal: On day xinchou he reviewed merit in pacifying Wu; Li Shanchang was enfeoffed Duke of Xuan, Xu Da Duke of Xin, Chang Yuchun Duke of E, and soldiers and officers received graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he reviewed merit in pacifying Wu: Li Shanchang was made Duke of Xuan, Xu Da Duke of Xin, Chang Yuchun Duke of E, and officers and soldiers received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 硃亮祖克台州。

translations.literal: Zhu Liangzu took Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Liangzu captured Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，新宮成。

translations.literal: On day guimao the new palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the new palace was completed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，遣起居注吳琳、魏觀以幣求遺賢於四方。

translations.literal: On day jiachen in the tenth month of winter he sent imperial diarists Wu Lin and Wei Guan with gifts to seek worthy men throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the tenth month of winter he sent imperial diarists Wu Lin and Wei Guan with gifts to seek worthy men in every quarter.

sentences.zh: 丙午，令百官禮儀尚左。

translations.literal: On day bingwu he ordered that ceremonial precedence in the bureaucracy honor the left.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he ordered that official ceremony honor the left.

sentences.zh: 改李善長左相國，徐達右相國。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang was made left chief councillor, Xu Da right chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang was made left chief councillor and Xu Da right chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀元臣余闕於安慶，李黼於江州。

translations.literal: On day xinhai he sacrificed to the Yuan loyalists Yu Que at Anqing and Li Fu at Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day he offered sacrifice to the Yuan loyalists Yu Que at Anqing and Li Fu at Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，置御史台。

translations.literal: On day renzi the Censorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Censorate was established.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，湯和為征南將軍，吳禎副之，討國珍。

translations.literal: On day guichou Tang He was made grand general for the southern expedition and Wu Zhen his deputy, to attack Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Tang He was made grand general for the southern expedition and Wu Zhen his deputy, to campaign against Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，定律令。

translations.literal: On day jiayin laws and ordinances were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day laws and ordinances were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 戊午，正郊社、太廟雅樂。

translations.literal: On day wuwu the ritual music of the suburban altars and Imperial Temple was corrected.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the ceremonial music of the suburban altars and Imperial Temple was set right.

sentences.zh: 庚申，召諸將議北征。

translations.literal: On day gengshen he summoned the generals to discuss the northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he summoned his commanders to discuss the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「山東則王宣反側，河南則擴廓跋扈，關隴則李思齊、張思道梟張猜忌，元祚將亡，中原塗炭。

translations.literal: Taizu said: "In Shandong Wang Xuan wavers; in Henan Köke Temür is overbearing; in Guan and Long Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao are fierce, jealous, and suspicious—the Yuan mandate is dying and the central plain is in ashes.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu said, "In Shandong Wang Xuan is unreliable; in Henan Köke Temür is arrogant; in Guan and Long Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao are fierce, jealous, and suspicious. The Yuan mandate is failing and the central plain is charred earth.

sentences.zh: 今將北伐，拯生民於水火，何以決勝？

translations.literal: We are about to march north to lift the people out of fire and flood—how shall we secure victory?"
translations.idiomatic: We are about to march north and lift the people out of fire and flood—how shall we win?"

sentences.zh: 」遇春對曰：「以我百戰之師，敵彼久逸之卒，直搗元都，破竹之勢也。

translations.literal: Yuchun replied: "With our army hardened in a hundred battles against their long-idle troops, driving straight at the Yuan capital would be like splitting bamboo."
translations.idiomatic: Yuchun answered, "Pit our army, hardened in a hundred battles, against their troops long at ease, and a straight drive on the Yuan capital will go like splitting bamboo."

sentences.zh: 」太祖曰：「元建國百年，守備必固，懸軍深入，饋餉不前，援兵四集，危道也。

translations.literal: Taizu said: "The Yuan have ruled a hundred years; their defenses must be firm. To march deep with no supplies following, while reinforcements gather from four sides—that is a perilous path.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu said, "The Yuan have ruled a hundred years; their defenses must be strong. To march deep with no supplies coming up behind while reinforcements gather on every side—that is a deadly road.

sentences.zh: 吾欲先取山東，撤彼屏蔽，移兵兩河，破其籓籬，拔潼關而守之，扼其戶檻。

translations.literal: I wish first to take Shandong and strip away their screen, then shift forces to the two rivers and break their outer fence, seize Tong Pass and hold it, and choke their gate.
translations.idiomatic: I mean first to take Shandong and strip away their screen, then shift to the two rivers and break their outer fence, seize Tong Pass and hold it, and choke their doorway.

sentences.zh: 天下形勝入我掌握，然後進兵，元都勢孤援絕，不戰自克。

translations.literal: Once the empire's strategic points are in our grasp, we advance; the Yuan capital will stand alone without aid and fall without a battle.
translations.idiomatic: When the empire's strong points are in our hands, we advance; the Yuan capital will stand alone without aid and fall without a fight.

sentences.zh: 鼓行而西，雲中、九原、關隴可席捲也。

translations.literal: Marching west in force, Yunzhong, Jiuyuan, Guan, and Long can be swept up."
translations.idiomatic: Then march west in force and Yunzhong, Jiuyuan, Guan, and Long can be swept up in turn."

sentences.zh: 」諸將皆曰善。

translations.literal: All the generals said it was good.
translations.idiomatic: All the commanders agreed that the plan was sound.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徐達為征虜大將軍，常遇春為副將軍，帥師二十五萬，由淮入河，北取中原。

translations.literal: On day jiazi Xu Da was made grand general for the extermination of barbarians and Chang Yuchun vice grand general, commanding two hundred fifty thousand men from the Huai into the Yellow River to seize the central plain northward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Xu Da was made grand general for the extermination of the barbarians and Chang Yuchun vice grand general, leading two hundred fifty thousand men from the Huai into the Yellow River to take the central plain.

sentences.zh: 胡廷瑞為征南將軍，何文輝為副將軍，取福建。

translations.literal: Hu Tingrui was made grand general for the southern expedition and He Wenhui vice grand general, to take Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Tingrui was made grand general for the southern expedition and He Wenhui vice grand general, to conquer Fujian.

sentences.zh: 湖廣行省平章楊璟、左丞周德興、參政張彬取廣西。

translations.literal: Yang Jing, left branch secretariat administrator of Huguang, Zhou Dexing vice administrator, and Zhang Bin administrative commissioner took Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jing, left branch secretariat administrator of Huguang, Zhou Dexing vice administrator, and Zhang Bin administrative commissioner were sent to take Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，硃亮祖克溫州。

translations.literal: On day jisi Zhu Liangzu took Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Zhu Liangzu captured Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，湯和克慶元，方國珍遁入海。

translations.literal: On day xinsi in the eleventh month Tang He took Qingyuan; Fang Guozhen fled to sea.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the eleventh month Tang He took Qingyuan; Fang Guozhen fled to the sea.

sentences.zh: 壬午，徐達克沂州，斬王宣。

translations.literal: On day renwu Xu Da took Yizhou and beheaded Wang Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Xu Da took Yizhou and beheaded Wang Xuan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，廖永忠為征南副將軍，自海道會和討國珍。

translations.literal: On day jichou Liao Yongzhong was made vice grand general for the southern expedition and joined Tang He by sea route to attack Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Liao Yongzhong was made vice grand general for the southern expedition and joined Tang He by sea to attack Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 乙未，頒《大統曆》。

translations.literal: On day yiwei the Dadu Calendar was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Dadu Calendar was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，徐達克益都。

translations.literal: On day xinchou Xu Da took Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xu Da captured Yidu.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，頒律令。

translations.literal: On day jiachen in the twelfth month laws and ordinances were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the twelfth month laws and ordinances were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丁未，方國珍降，浙東平。

translations.literal: On day dingwei Fang Guozhen surrendered and eastern Zhe was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Fang Guozhen surrendered and eastern Zhe was pacified.

sentences.zh: 張興祖下東平，兗東州縣相繼降。

translations.literal: Zhang Xingzu took Dongping; eastern Yan commanderies and counties surrendered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xingzu took Dongping; commanderies and counties east of Yan submitted one after another.

sentences.zh: 己酉，徐達下濟南。

translations.literal: On day jiyou Xu Da took Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Xu Da took Jinan.

sentences.zh: 胡廷瑞下邵武。

translations.literal: Hu Tingrui took Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Tingrui took Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李善長帥百官勸進，表三上，乃許。

translations.literal: On day guichou Li Shanchang led the hundred officials in urging him to ascend; thrice they submitted the memorial before he consented.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Li Shanchang led the hundred officials in urging him to take the throne; three times they submitted the memorial before he assented.

sentences.zh: 甲子，告於上帝。

translations.literal: On day jiazi he announced it to God on High.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he announced his accession to God on High.

sentences.zh: 庚午，湯和、廖永忠由海道克福州。

translations.literal: On day gengwu Tang He and Liao Yongzhong took Fuzhou by the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Tang He and Liao Yongzhong took Fuzhou by sea.
